scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,cms,api -c magenta,cyan,green "npm run dev -w @echo/web" "npm run dev -w @echo/cms" "npm run dev -w @echo/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @echo/web && npm run build -w @echo/cms
scripts.start: concurrently -n web,cms,api -c magenta,cyan,green "npm run start -w @echo/web" "npm run start -w @echo/cms" "npm run start -w @echo/api"
